question: In which year was badminton officially introduced in the Olympics?A. 1992B. 1972C. 1896D. 1968 (RRB NTPC Tier I (28/04/2016) Shift 3)
options: C
B
A
D
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 1992

Explanation:
Badminton was officially introduced as an Olympic sport at the Barcelona 1992 Games. Prior to that, it was a demonstration sport at the 1972 Munich Olympics, but it was not contested for medals until 1992. The inclusion of badminton in the Olympics was driven by its growing international popularity. The first Olympic badminton events included men's singles, women's singles, and doubles. Mixed doubles was added later at Atlanta 1996. Badminton traces its origins to British India in the 19th century. Today, it is particularly popular in Asian countries like China, Indonesia, Korea, and India.

☛ Which country has the most Olympic medals in badminton? → China

question: Which Nation has hosted the Commonwealth Games five times? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (28/12/2020) Shift 2)
options: New Zealand
England
Canada
Australia
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Australia

Explanation:
Australia has hosted the Commonwealth Games five times: 1938 (Sydney), 1962 (Perth), 1982 (Brisbane), 2006 (Melbourne), and 2018 (Gold Coast). This is the highest number of hostings by any nation. The Commonwealth Games are held every four years, featuring countries from the Commonwealth. Australia has not only been a frequent host but also tops the medal tally. England has hosted three times (1934, 2002, 2022), Canada thrice (1930, 1954, 1994), and New Zealand thrice (1950, 1974, 1990). The 2018 Gold Coast Games in Australia were particularly successful.
